title: Tangent Compound Formulas
text:
The tangent compound angle formulas are:
- $$\tan(A + B) = \frac{\tan A + \tan B}{1 - \tan A \tan B}$$
- $$\tan(A - B) = \frac{\tan A - \tan B}{1 + \tan A \tan B}$$

title: Memory Aid
text:
For tan(A + B): numerator has PLUS, denominator has MINUS
For tan(A - B): numerator has MINUS, denominator has PLUS

Think: opposite signs in numerator and denominator.

hintAnswer: (tan A + tan B)/(1 - tan A tan B)
